facts.fact: CBOS Circular 7/2026 of 31 March 2026 sets binding minimum USSD rules and cites the Payment Systems Regulation 2013 and the 2020 mobile-payment financial institutions licensing regulation as its basis.
facts.system: Payment Systems Regulation 2013; Mobile Payment Financial Institutions Regulation 2020

facts.fact: The circular lets mobile-payment financial institutions and electronic payment providers licensed by the central bank offer USSD financial services alongside banks, on production of their CBOS licence certificate.
The circular obliges all payment service providers to connect their USSD platforms to the central national switch, 'when available', for interoperability; no deadline is set.

systems.owner: Central Bank of Sudan (regulator); banks, mobile-payment institutions and e-payment providers operate
